server_description: Semantic and full-text search over the English notes vault. Read daily notes, manage tasks, and index notes.

query_notes.description: Hybrid semantic + full-text search over the notes vault. Returns ranked results merging vector similarity and FTS5 keyword search via RRF. Supports filtering by note type, tag, and date range.

get_daily_note.description: Read the daily note for a given date expression (today, yesterday, YYYY-MM-DD). Creates the note from template if it does not exist.

add_task.description: Add a task checkbox '- [ ] task' to the daily note under a specified category (e.g., 'Work', 'Personal').

complete_task.description: Mark a task as completed [x] in the daily note by matching task text.

get_note.description: Read the full content of a note by its relative vault path (e.g., 'zettelkasten/example.md').

list_notes.description: List notes within a directory or of a specific type (journal, zettelkasten, projects, finanzas, etc.).

index_vault.description: (Re)build the semantic search index. By default incremental (fast). Set full_rebuild=true for a complete rebuild (runs in background).

index_status.description: Return the current index status: notes indexed, chunks, pending changes, and embedding model.

create_zettel.description: Create a new atomic Zettelkasten note with mandatory YAML frontmatter (title, tags, date).

errors.vault_not_found: Notes vault not found at {path}. Set NOTES_VAULT_PATH.
errors.ollama_unavailable: Cannot connect to Ollama at {url}. Is it running? Try: ollama pull {model}
errors.daily_note_not_found: Daily note for {date} not found and could not be created.
errors.task_not_found: No matching pending task found for '{query}' in daily note {date}.
